## Purpose
The shared building blocks of both sidebars (the user app's and the admin console's): a section heading, a link, a footer button and a header icon button, so the two behave the same.

## Responsibilities
- Exports `NavSection` (a collapsible section), `NavLink` (active styling and collapsed-icon mode), and the class helpers `footerButton` and `headerIconButton`.
